meta.title: Team & Story — Bhoomi Bytes
meta.description: Meet the team behind Bhoomi Bytes — an engineering student team from West Bengal building IoT and AI-powered smart agriculture technology. Finalists at BhabnaJU 1.0, IIC Jadavpur University.

hero.title: Built by Students. Driven by Purpose.
hero.subtitle: We are a team of engineering students from West Bengal who believe that technology can transform Indian agriculture — starting with the farmers who need it most.

origin.title: From a Classroom Observation to a Real Problem
paragraphs: Bhoomi Bytes began with a simple observation: Indian farmers, especially small and medium-scale growers, were making critical decisions about irrigation, soil health, and crop management based on experience and intuition alone — without access to real-time data.

We saw an opportunity. IoT sensors, microcontrollers, and AI models had become affordable enough to deploy in the field. Weather APIs were freely available. The technology existed — it just hadn't been assembled into a practical, farmer-focused platform.

So we built one. Starting with a proof-of-concept using ESP32 microcontrollers and soil moisture sensors, we developed Bhoomi Bytes — an integrated platform that collects real-time field data, processes it with AI, and delivers actionable recommendations directly to the farmer.

team.title: Who We Are
team.intro: We are a focused engineering team combining expertise in AI & data engineering, software development, embedded systems, and user experience design.

members.name: Priyam Sarkar
members.focus: AI & Data Engineering | Machine Learning & Crop Intelligence
members.bio: Founder and lead developer of Bhoomi Bytes. Responsible for the AI recommendation engine, crop-specific intelligence models, data pipeline design, and system architecture. Works on translating raw sensor data into actionable farming insights.

members.name: Anirban Dalui
members.focus: Frontend & UX Engineering | Dashboard Design & Farmer Experience
members.bio: Co-founder of Bhoomi Bytes, responsible for the farmer-facing dashboard and mobile experience. Focused on creating intuitive interfaces that make complex sensor data accessible and actionable for farmers.

items.title: Farmer First
items.desc: Every feature we build is evaluated through one lens: does this make a farmer's life better? Technology for its own sake is not our goal.

items.title: Evidence-Based
items.desc: We build on real data — sensor readings, weather patterns, crop science research. Our recommendations are grounded in evidence, not guesswork.

items.title: Practical & Affordable
items.desc: We design for the constraints of real Indian farms — limited connectivity, budget sensitivity, and the need for simple, reliable tools.

items.title: Open to Collaboration
items.desc: We actively seek partnerships with agricultural institutions, cooperatives, and government programs to amplify our impact.

bhabnaju.title: Our First Major Milestone
bhabnaju.intro: Being selected as a finalist at BhabnaJU 1.0 was a defining moment for Bhoomi Bytes — our first external validation that the idea had real merit.

what.label: What is BhabnaJU?
what.desc: BhabnaJU 1.0 is an ideation and innovation workshop program organized by the Institution's Innovation Council (IIC) at Jadavpur University — one of India's most prestigious technical institutions. The program brings together student innovators to develop, present, and refine early-stage ideas across technology, science, and social impact.

timeline.desc: Developed the core concept: an integrated IoT + AI platform for small-scale Indian farmers, focused on soil monitoring and smart irrigation.
Built an early hardware prototype using ESP32 microcontrollers and soil moisture sensors, paired with a basic data dashboard.
Submitted the concept to BhabnaJU 1.0 under the Technology & Applied Science category at IIC, Jadavpur University.
Selected as a finalist — participated in workshops, presented to evaluators, received structured feedback, and refined the solution.
Continuing to develop the platform, expand sensor capabilities, and build toward a pilot deployment with real farmers in West Bengal.

bhabnaju.quote: BhabnaJU gave us more than recognition — it gave us a framework for thinking about our solution rigorously, and the confidence to keep building.

cta.title: Want to Follow Our Journey?
cta.subtitle: We are actively looking for mentors, agricultural partners, and early pilot farms. If you believe in what we are building, we would love to connect.
